declared_before_the_runs.P1: every reported flag is sourced: the citation names the file, the line, and the declaration it came from
declared_before_the_runs.P2: the follower never executes anything and never writes; it is a bounded read with a depth budget
declared_before_the_runs.P3: correctness first: sourced precision of the flags vs what the program's own parser accepts is reported, and volume alone never counts as success
declared_before_the_runs.P4: the follower is measured against ASK on a host whose artifacts contain no flags at all (the venv), because that is the host where reading bytes previously failed
declared_before_the_runs.P5: a pointer that leads nowhere is reported as a dead end, not smoothed into a success
declared_before_the_runs.P6: zero model calls, zero stored parameters, no network
declared_before_the_runs.P7: reach and usability are separated, and nesting is decided by the artifact's own interface rather than by decorator proximity: a program whose usage declares a COMMAND/subcommand slot hides its command-decorated flags one level down, while a command-decorated program with no subcommand slot exposes them at the top level
declared_before_the_runs.P8: a nesting decision is only made from the artifact's own declared usage or from an AST fact (a group whose own text lists subcommands); when neither is available the flags are reported as undecidable rather than guessed in either direction
declared_before_the_runs.P9: the scorer does not assume ASK's help text is the whole interface: flags the follower declares but help omits are broken down by actually exercising them, so a disagreement is classified as either an error by the follower or an omission by help
